title: How Donald Trump makes money – level 1
paragraphs: Donald Trump is the president of the United States. He makes more than 1.4 billion dollars from digital money in 2025. A new financial report shows that digital assets are now his biggest source of money.

Trump and his sons have a business called World Liberty Financial. They sell digital coins. They make hundreds of millions of dollars. In 2025, Trump becomes president again. His family makes billions of dollars from this business. A White House worker says that everything is legal and fair. Trump has other businesses, too. He has golf clubs and hotels. They bring him over 500 million dollars last year.

words.d: something a person or company has, for example, a house, land, or money
